specs.prompt:
Redesign the existing logo in image1 into the CURRENT game art style shown in images2-3. Deliver ONE compact SQUARE 1:1 brand mark on a REAL TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, generous 8% transparent padding all around, no mockup, no additional sheet/panel or scene background.
Exact Chinese title, every character complete and readable: 交子赶工记. Two lines, upper 交子 large, lower 赶工记 together, compact nearly-square overall silhouette. The characters should be lively hand-cut Chinese brush lettering reinterpreted in broad angular cut-paper planes, playful slight tilt but proper strokes, crafted visual rhythm, flat vermilion red characters with thin ivory cut-paper edging and a restrained darker redbrown offset paper layer. A fine muted teal silhouette edge may unify the mark, NOT a thick shiny badge. Few deliberate facets/fold edges within major strokes, not random fractures. Internal white paper gaps remain clear at small scale. Not rounded bubble font, furry lettering, heavy foam extrusion, bevelled gold or plastic gloss. Keep game identity original, not another franchise's lettering.
Only TWO tiny supporting motifs integrated around the word shape: upper-left ONE cream Jiaozi paper note with simple geometric border and small square-hole bronze coin; lower-right ONE compact vermilion square seal mark. They must support the type without obscuring any character. No animals, human portraits, weapons, stars, clouds surrounding the whole mark, busy decorations, English subtitle, slogans or extra words.
Palette consistent with the updated game: warm ivory #F4E6C6, vermilion #BC4931, redbrown #713F30, teal #277B77 used sparingly, amber #D6A443. Clear scissor-cut edges, short shallow paper overlap shadows, flat saturated color planes, faint restrained paper tooth only, no high-frequency cracks or grain. Image2 is geometric paper material language only; do not copy its animal or text. Image3 provides current game's palette, calm geometry and layering. Image1 supplies title and 2-line brand composition; replace its heavy three-dimensional ivory letter style. Premium readable Chinese game logo, square canvas, genuine alpha transparency outside the mark.

specs.prompt:
Create ONE finished full-screen LANDSCAPE 16:9 main menu for the Chinese co-op game 交子赶工记. User's exact concept: 游戏主页是交子铺的台面，不用角色在台面. Use image1 as PRIMARY COMPOSITION reference: front-facing interior of a Song-era Jiaozi paper-money shop, large upper-center game logo, real counter spanning full width below, grouped papermaking/printing objects on its top, four menu tags aligned across front of counter. Image2 is secondary inspiration only for credible shop-counter depth, shelving and objects placed on surfaces. Image3 is the CURRENT LOGO design to reproduce faithfully. Images4/5 supply the unified geometric CUT-PAPER visual language and clean palette, not their characters or interface contents.
ABSOLUTELY NO people, animals, mascot bodies, toy figures, character portraits or figurines anywhere on or behind the counter. No cat shopkeeper. No modern television/phone/plastic mug or electronics. No currency/energy bars/account IDs/tasks/mailbox/friend/menu overlays from image2. Only the game's four requested main menu buttons.
Preserve the primary reference's arrangement: a well-built reddish-brown wooden counter at y≈62%-82% with clearly visible top horizontal plane and coherent front apron/posts below. Camera gently elevated, nearly frontal, logical shared vanishing directions. Every object rests on its top with small short contact shadow; no floating or intersecting props. View feels like standing in front of a real small traditional paper shop translated into paper collage, not a diagram or room-wide game level.
Left tabletop group: tidy stack of cream Jiaozi banknotes with simple dark printed coin/woodcut borders bound by one redbrown paper band; two small cinnabar seal blocks next to it; THREE to FIVE square-hole copper coins lying naturally, not scattered densely. Center countertop mostly clear, open breathing room under logo. Right group: low charcoal inkstone with one cream-tipped brush resting across edge, opened ivory account ledger with a few large red ruling lines (no dense gibberish), tall simple muted-teal brush/paper holder on far right.
Background: visible orderly Song-inspired timber beams and upright columns with coherent joinery; one broad rectilinear lattice window behind logo, warm ivory daylight shining through it, limited muted teal/sage shapes beyond; a small shelf right with two or three rolled-paper bundles and one plain earthenware jar. One modest vermilion paper lantern each side. Top corners only simple redbrown folded curtain edges. No forest/cloud wallpaper, cluttered tiny objects, dense foliage, unnecessary signs, gilded palace trim or huge platform.
Use image3's EXACT rounded lettering and emblem silhouette prominently upper-center: 交子 above, 赶工记 below, warm vermilion letters, cream/gold thin layered backing, muted teal outside edge, small note/coin at upper-left, cloud upper-right, tiny red seal at right. Match this logo rather than earlier angular letters. Render as thin hanging cut-paper shop sign with two simple cords supported by beam, not a 3D foam sculpture. Logo comfortably dominates center without covering lanterns, shelf or countertop objects; approx 48% screen width, keep all 5 characters readable. No black/transparent-square background rectangle around logo.
Along counter's FRONT apron at bottom y≈82%-94% place precisely FOUR aligned clean paper-sign buttons, each physically attached with tiny restrained pin/cord, excellent hierarchy and generous readable spacing:
1 largest vermilion red sign with ivory text 开始营业;
2 smaller warm-ivory sign with desaturated warm-grey text 继续 (subdued disabled appearance as a fresh-save example);
3 warm-ivory sign dark brown text 图鉴;
4 warm-ivory sign dark brown text 设置.
Same clipped-corner silhouette and shallow paper thickness as image4's buttons. NO huge thick gold ornamental frames, no extra menu text. Entire bottom row inside safe margins. Do not put big buttons ON the work surface among props.
Style: broad expressive geometric paper planes in wood/props, layered cut cardboard with clean precise edges, few deliberate fold planes, subtle short consistent shadows, calm smooth cream/redbrown paper areas. Not heavy realistic textured timber, furry characters, glossy plastic, low-poly CGI room, painterly black linework or noisy grunge. Very faint local paper grain only. Color distribution: warm clear ivory light, rich redbrown #713F30 structural frame/counter, vermilion #BC4931 main accents and logo, muted teal #277B77 limited accents, amber #D6A443 coins and warm edges. Harmonize new logo/setting/selection pages, retain cheerful warmth without turning scene all orange. Mature polished art direction, no busy high-frequency decorations. Main readable story is Jiaozi paperwork and the four menu choices.

specs.prompt:
Create one finished full-screen 16:9 LANDSCAPE GAME SETTINGS page for 交子赶工记, matching the NEW art language of image1. This is a complete polished illustrated UI image, not code, wireframe, component sheet or phone screenshot. Image1 supplies current geometric papercut art/palette/typography/buttons and smooth redbrown background curve. Image2 supplies the existing settings control semantics ONLY (ignore its plain HTML look, grey game blur, outdated human game setting and preview-only controls). Image3 supplies deliberate folded paper material, not its animal or text.
Composition: a warm reddish-chestnut #713F30 flat paper area across LEFT third and curving gently into the BOTTOM quarter, joined to a large clean ivory #F4E6C6 field on the right. Boundary is ONE flowing broad clean diagonal CURVE as image1, absolutely NO stair steps, jagged triangles, protruding fold strip or pale lip. Calm, spacious, low detail.
Upper-left small ivory back-arrow. Left-center large beautiful dark-ivory brush title 游戏设置 arranged in two stacked pairs 游戏 / 设置, generously spaced, smaller than a character title. Under it a small thin flat woodblock-printing plate, square bronze coin and folded paper sheet arranged as ONE tasteful geometric cut-paper still life near lower-left, visibly folded paper with short shadows; no real character or portrait. A few faint warmbeige window/beam silhouettes on cream background only, not a busy game scene. No long subtext.
RIGHT two-thirds hold ONE broad cream paper settings form, occupying x≈34%-94%, y≈10%-90%, subtly overlapping a slightly darker backing sheet with 4 softly clipped corners and very thin redbrown rule, short shadow, no bulky gold frame. Rows neatly aligned with wide air:
Small section label 声音, followed by three equally spaced rows with precise legible labels:
总音量   [paper slider at 70%] 70%
音乐     [paper slider at 35%] 35%
音效     [paper slider at 65%] 65%
Sliders are flat cream/desaturated tan tracks with vermilion filled portions, little ochre circular square-hole-coin thumbs, same thickness, no chrome/3D bevel/glow. Knob location must match each numerical percentage (roughly 70/35/65 along track). First slider can have a thin quiet focus outline.
Thin short divider, then small section label 画面.
Row: 全屏显示   square paper check box with vermilion ✓ and 开.
Row: 分辨率   simple paper selector displaying 1920 × 1080 with tiny downward chevron.
Below small clean 查看操作说明 with arrow (view controls only, not remapping). No on-screen keyboard clutter.
Bottom form two horizontally balanced buttons: ivory secondary 取消 and vermilion primary 保存设置, matched clipped-corner paper shape, short shadow, warm ivory primary text, same family as image1. These labels are exact. No reset, language, graphics-quality, gamepad, network, account, currency, health, resume or restart buttons; no preview canvas size or reduced-motion control.
All text in Chinese, clearly readable. Same restrained Chinese brush font for heading/labels and calm numerals as current UI, not every label huge calligraphy. Geometric cut-paper collage: broad well-designed colored planes, limited hard folds only in props, tiny overlap shadows, clean edges, subtle paper tooth no dirty noise or grunge. No animals or humans anywhere. Decorative elements must stay at perimeter; form is the focus. Do not copy original reference's R/SR, card art or text. Finished warm Chinese Song papermill setting screen with cohesive, uncluttered art.
